$comment: BudgetMint's own project (budgetmint, .firebaserc): its Firestore rules (rules/firestore.rules) and its Hosting site, both deployed by BudgetMint's release. firebase/firestore.rules is TaskMint's, pinned, for the tests only. The emulators are in firebase.emulators.json. Headers: the first rule's apply everywhere. Cache-Control comes from exactly one of the other two, since Hosting doesn't say which wins when two rules set the same header: /assets/ holds Vite's content-hashed files, kept for a year; everything else (the page at every route, /sw.js, the manifest, icons and static pages) is checked with the server on every load, so a release shows at once and the service worker finds its new version.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' https://apis.google.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://firestore.googleapis.com https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com; frame-src 'self' https://budgetmint.firebaseapp.com https://taskmint-f9a05.firebaseapp.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'
